Kaavakuva: energiaketju Auringosta pyörä: Diagram: an energy chain from the Sun to cycling. The Sun sends radiation energy, a plant (oats) stores it as chemical energy in food, the muscles turn part of it into the motion of the bicycle and the rest is heat. At every step part of the energy turns into heat in the surroundings (orange arrows pointing down), and finally the motion also turns into heat. The lengths of the arrows are not to scale.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: energia jouleina: Scale diagram: energy in joules on a power-of-ten scale from 1 J to 10 TJ and beyond. Each step is a factor of ten. An apple lifted one metre is about 1 J, a burning match about 1 kJ, a day's food about 10 MJ, a 50-litre petrol tank about 1.6 GJ, and the Olkiluoto 3 nuclear power plant produces about 140 TJ of electricity in a day.
jokainen väli on 10-kertainen: each step is a factor of 10
Kaavakuva mittakaavassa (esimerkki): pyö: Scale diagram (example): of the 800 kJ of chemical energy in a cyclist's morning porridge, the muscles turn 200 kJ into motion and 600 kJ into heat. The width of the arrows is proportional to the energy, and the combined width of the branches equals the width of the original arrow.
nuolen leveys kuvaa energian määrää: the width of the arrow shows the amount of energy
